Kalon'ny — « la voix, le style » en malg: Kalon'ny—“voice, style” in Malagasy—was born from a simple observation: learning an instrument in Madagascar too often means choosing between a distant conservatory and teaching yourself. We wanted to offer a middle ground rooted in tradition, guided by real teachers, and designed for the country.
